method unique_digits(x: seq<int>) returns (result: seq<int>)
    requires |x| > 0  // The input list should have at least one element
    ensures forall i, j :: 0 <= i < j < |result| ==> result[i] < result[j]  // The result should be sorted in increasing order
    ensures forall a :: a in result ==> forall d :: d in digits(a) ==> d % 2 != 0  // All digits in the result elements are odd
    ensures result == [y | y in x | !has_even_digit(y)]  // The result should contain only the elements from x that have no even digits

// Helper method to check if a number has any even digit
method has_even_digit(n: int) returns (result: bool)
    requires n >= 0
    ensures result <==> exists d :: d in digits(n) && d % 2 == 0

// Helper method to extract digits from a number
method digits(n: int) returns (d: seq<int>)
    requires n >= 0
    ensures |d| > 0 ==> d[0] == n % 10  // The first digit of the sequence is the last digit of n
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |d| ==> d[i] == (n / (10^i)) % 10  // Each digit corresponds to the respective place value
```
